## Cross-repo mesh — `dsh-createos`

**DeepSeek Harness integration**, one package of [`createos-plugin`](https://github.com/NodeOps-app/createos-plugin). Replaces the harness filesystem, subprocess and PTY layers. Pins `@nodeops-createos/sandbox` — the only exact SDK pin in this repo.

### What ripples into this package

This package pins the TypeScript SDK, so a wire change reaches it through an SDK release, not through the CLI. Bumping the pin is part of shipping that change.

User-visible changes here are documented at `Integrations/DeepSeek-Harness` in [`createos-v2-landing`](https://github.com/NodeOps-app/createos-v2-landing). Keep the two in step.

The full repo graph, what counts as a shared surface, and the ripple
protocol live in the monorepo root [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md), which is
loaded automatically from this directory.
